headerPrompts.Overview: write a concise overview of this repository describing its purpose, scope, and role within the organization
headerPrompts.Requirements: list the prerequisites and requirements needed to use or develop this repository
headerPrompts.Installation: describe how to install or set up this repository for the first time
headerPrompts.Usage: describe the primary usage patterns and commands for this repository
headerPrompts.Structure.Overview: describe the repository structure, key directories, and how documentation, automation, and implementation files are organized
headerPrompts.Organization.Overview: describe how this repository is organized, including repository type, template inheritance, and ownership context
headerPrompts.Roadmap.Overview: summarize the roadmap, delivery phases, and release progression planned for this repository
headerPrompts.Roadmap.ToDoList: infer to-do list items from the roadmap description, including key milestones, deliverables, and timelines for this repository. you can use `gh` cli
headerPrompts.Architecture.Overview: write a concise technical architecture overview describing the system boundaries, layers, and design goals for this repository
headerPrompts.Architecture.Structure: describe the architectural layers, main directories, integration points, and responsibilities of each part of this repository
headerPrompts.Architecture.Technologies: list and describe the key technologies, frameworks, runtimes, and tooling used in this repository
headerPrompts.Architecture.Components: list and describe the main system components, modules, and their responsibilities within this repository
headerPrompts.Structure.Structure: describe the directive system used in this repository, including LLM directives for narrative content and CMR directives for generated inventories, with active mappings by file, validation commands, and configuration resolution policy

headerPrompts.Structure.SemanticHeaders: describe the standardized semantic header vocabulary used across documentation, list all emoji prefixes with their name, category, description, and example usages

headerPrompts.Structure.References: list references to related documentation files for this repository structure document
